Proof in the paper: The X-ray diffraction measurement (XRD) was performed. As presented in Fig. 1a, two typical strong diffraction peaks located at 44.5°, and 51.8° are attributed to the diffraction peaks from the NF. And the remaining characteristic diffraction peaks centered at 11.54°, 23.21°, 34.47°, 38.96°, and 61.16° represent lattice planes of (003), (006), (100), (105) and (110) in LDH (JCPDS No. 46-0605), respectively.
